name: Shield Guardian
languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

trait.name: Bound
entries: The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The guardian regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}.

trait.name: Spell Storing
entries: A spellcaster who wears the guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian makes two Fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Force damage.

reaction.name: Protection
entries: {@actTrigger} An attack roll hits the wearer of the guardian's amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the guardian. {@actResponse} The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the guardian's next turn.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 27}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed, and the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} and {@condition Restrained|SRD52} conditions and can't teleport, it has {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 ({@damage 16d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns.

If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|SRD52}.

legendary.name: Onslaught
entries: The tarrasque moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendary.name: World-Shaking Movement
entries: The tarrasque moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}. At the end of this movement, the tarrasque creates an instantaneous shock wave in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose {@status Concentration|SRD52} and, if Medium or smaller, have the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. The tarrasque can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The tough has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 3}, range 100/400 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tough makes two attacks, using Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

action.name: Warhammer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the tough pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 100/400 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d10 + 2}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The treant makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hail of Bark
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 180 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
entries: The treant magically animates up to two trees it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each tree uses the Treant stat block, except it has Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, it can't speak, and it lacks this action. The tree takes its turn immediately after the treant on the same {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count, and it obeys the treant. A tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, the treant dies, or it is more than 120 feet from the treant. The tree then takes root if possible.

trait.name: Loathsome Limbs (4/Day)
entries: If the troll ends any turn {@status Bloodied|SRD52} and took 15+ Slashing damage during that turn, one of the troll's limbs is severed, falls into the troll's space, and becomes a {@creature Troll Limb|SRD52}. The limb acts immediately after the troll's turn. The troll has 1 {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The troll regains 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The troll makes three Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Charge
entries: The troll moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} straight toward an enemy it can see.

entries: The limb regains 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} at the start of each of its turns. If the limb takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the limb's next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Troll Spawn
entries: The limb uncannily has the same senses as a whole troll. If the limb isn't destroyed within 24 hours, roll {@dice 1d12}. On a 12, the limb turns into a {@creature Troll|SRD52}. Otherwise, the limb withers away.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Slashing damage.
